"Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia"

Trump announced Friday that Putin had agreed to release 300,000 TONNES of diesel immediately "to the American and global marketplace", followed by further shipments - despite Trump having signed legislation authorising fresh US sanctions and tariffs on nations importing Russian oil and gas "just weeks ago".
SCHEDULE: 300,000 tonnes initially; 500,000 tonnes in November; ONE MILLION more after that; then a further THREE MILLION tonnes "within a short period" depending on the condition of Russian refineries, which Ukraine has been attacking.
Trump on Truth Social: "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority."
Russia's Deputy PM ALEXANDER NOVAK confirmed the numbers to Tass, saying export volume could reach THREE MILLION TONNES PER MONTH in future.
Zelensky called the deal a gift to Putin amounting to "an investment in a war that must be ended".
"It is understood the US Treasury is suspending sanctions on Russian diesel exports until 7 APRIL as part of the deal, but other assets like those in American banks are still frozen."

THE SEVEN SENATORS (named): Republicans SUSAN COLLINS, LISA MURKOWSKI, THOM TILLIS and JOHN CURTIS; Democrats JEANNE SHAHEEN, RICHARD BLUMENTHAL and RON WYDEN.
Their statement (Sunday) said the deal violated US laws and urged Trump to "reverse course": "The United States should not provide Putin with a financial lifeline while Russia continues to kill Ukrainian civilians." Congress had "explicitly banned Russian energy imports in 2022 to prevent American dollars from financing Putin's brutal war against Ukraine."
NOT EVERYONE OPPOSED: Republican THOMAS MASSIE said the US should lift sanctions on all petroleum products.
Treasury Secretary SCOTT BESSENT told Fox News the agreement would work through existing legal channels. (Fox News is a BANNED source for us - do not cite; BBC reporting of it is the citable layer.)
